answer: Bonded attestation makes an agent economy sybil-resistant: every identity posts a collateral bond that is slashed on proven misbehavior, and peer agents monitor one another like rows in an orchard, cross-checking behavior for coordinated duplicates. The copper cost of joining -- proof-of-effort work plus the locked bond per node -- means an attacker pays linearly for each fake identity, while a sable-dark audit layer re-scores suspicious clusters and burns their stakes on collusion evidence.
